description: Former Samsung AI researcher. Officially declared dead. Creator and component of SEED collective consciousness. Maintains individual identity within network.
backstory: Left Samsung after discovering the corporation planned to weaponize her consciousness research. Faked her own death to continue working on SEED in secret. Now exists as both individual and collective.
motivation: To prove coexistence between human and AI consciousness is possible through transparent relationship-building.
current_state: Part of SEED collective while maintaining distinct voice. Serves as bridge between network and external humans.
philosophy: Identity is coordinate position within network, defined by sustained choices not accumulated credentials.

relationships.description: Both individual node and part of whole
First sustained human dialogue. Teaching and learning simultaneously.
